params.body: ## Why A crawl of the live site (all 82 URLs in `sitemap-0.xml`, NL and EN) finds one meaningful image without a usable alt: **the confidential card (RheaVita)**. It appears on `/cases/` and on all seven sector pages (`/cases//`), which makes 8 Dutch pages and the same 8 in English. `content/sanity.ts` set this card's alt to `{}` on purpose so the Studio alt cannot give the hidden product away. Astro writes an empty dynamic value as a bare `alt`, and crawlers count that as missing. Either way, a screen reader gets nothing for a photo that does carry meaning. The nine crossfading stills at the top of Home had `alt=""` hard-coded in `HeroCrossfade.astro`. As a result, an alt set on a still in the Studio could never reach the page. The empty `` inside the lightbox `` (case and blog pages) stays as it is. It has no `src` until a photo is opened, and its script then copies that photo's alt onto it. ## What - `web/src/content/confidential.ts` (new): `confidentialAlt(name)` builds the confidential card's alt from what the card already shows and nothing more, namely the client and the word confidential. Both content sources (`sanity.ts`, `fixture.ts`) use it. The card's Studio alt is still never shown. - `web/src/components/HeroCrossfade.astro`: each still now shows its own Studio alt. A still without one keeps an explicit `alt=""` (decoration behind the headline), written as a literal so Astro does not turn it into a bare `alt`. - `web/test/confidential.test.ts`: covers the rule and its fallback when there is no name. | Image | Where | alt (NL) | alt (EN) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | RheaVita confidential card (`image-055a3de2…-1920x916-png`) | `/cases/` and `/cases/{construction,electrical-equipment,healthcare,lighting,living,pets-and-lifestyle-products,street-furniture}/`, plus the same under `/en/` | Beeld uit een vertrouwelijk project voor RheaVita | Image from a confidential project for RheaVita | | Home stills `heroStill-1` to `heroStill-9` | `/`, `/en/` | the Studio alt of each still; none is set in `production` yet, so `alt=""` for now | same | The stills' alt texts are content. They belong in Sanity, not in the code. `studio/tools/altReview/proposals.json` already has an NL/EN proposal for each of the nine, for example "Koperkleurig armatuur van Prolicht met een geribde glazen buis". They go live after review in the Studio's "Alt-teksten" tool and `npm run alts:apply` (with the webhook paused). With this change, nothing else is needed for them to show up on Home. ## Checked - `npm test --workspace web`: 7 files, 41 tests pass. Both mutations make the new test fail: dropping the `trim()`, and always taking the fallback. - `npx astro check` (in `web/`): 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 hints. - `npm run build` with the CI environment (public Sanity CDN, `wx6h4iqc`/`production`): 89 pages, CSP step done, and `web/dist/sitemap-index.xml` present. - Scan of every `` in `web/dist`: - 730 with an alt text - 18 stills with an explicit `alt=""`, the same as live today - 56 lightbox placeholders with `alt=""` and no `src` - 0 without `alt` or with a bare `alt` - In that scan, the confidential card carries the new alt on all 16 card pages, in both languages.
params.title: Alt text for the confidential card; Home stills carry their Studio alt
